title: Cecabank, Crédit Mutuel join Regulated Layer One tokenization platform as it launches
summary: Today SWIAT announced the official launch of the Regulated Layer One (RL1) blockchain cooperative, with SWIAT transferring its DLT platform to the Luxembourg organization. SWIAT continues to be the technical partner. Additionally, the group announced two new founding members, Spanish wholesale bank Cecabank, and the French umbrella cooperative Crédit Mutuel.
